definition: Anton Osika (born 10 August 1990) is a Swedish software engineer and entrepreneur.
details: Created the viral open-source `gpt-engineer` repository and founded Lovable, a leading natural-language app generation platform. He is the co-founder and chief executive officer of Lovable. Osika has also co-founded the companies Depict.ai and Sana Labs, and is known for creating the open-source AI coding project GPT-Engineer.

explainer.lead: Anton Osika is a Swedish entrepreneur (born 1990).

contributions.name: He was an early engineer at Sana Labs, a company developing AI-based learning and knowledge-management software, and reached a $500 million valuation.
He later co-founded Depict.ai, where he served as chief technology officer, developing machine-learning systems for e-commerce product recommendations.
In 2023, Osika released GPT-Engineer, an open-source tool designed to generate complete software projects from natural-language descriptions using large language models.
Later in 2023, Osika co-founded Lovable with Swedish entrepreneur Fabian Hedin.

timeline.what: Following a funding round for Lovable in December 2025 that valued the company at about $6.6 billion, Osika became a billionaire according to estimates by Forbes.
In 2025, Osika signed the Founders Pledge, committing to donate 50% of his net worth to meaningful causes if Lovable succeeds.
